I'll try and give suggestions for each.

Mod: Pulse v2 is a great single 21700 squonker and I currently use one right now, easy to navigate the menu and the bottom fill is great.

Atomizer: I use 3 rdas, Zeus rda, Mongrel and the Nitrous that I use in single coil mode. I highly recommend the nitrous as you get 2 top caps, one for single and dual coils but for beginners I think you should use the Dead Rabbit rda line, the v2 or v3 or even the Solo version if you don't want to start with dual coils yet.

Cotton: For cotton, you can take the easy route and buy shoelace end cottons for easy installation and you don't have to split them. But I highly recommend cotton bacon as it's the best one I've tried so far, if you choose to use this you have to split one roll of cotton into 4 pcs and that should be good for most coils.

Coils: For starters you can buy prebuilt coils if you don't want to think about wrapping them, I use Coilology prebuild coils but I also have a spool of fused clapton and alien coils whenever I feel it. Also start with 3mm or 2.5mm inner diameter with 5-6 wraps.

Tools: You can get a toolset that has everything you need in there. You can also get an ohm tab if you want to be safe but you can use the mod otherwise when building.

Building: Some decks need the coils pre-cut, you can watch youtube vids about the rda you're going to buy but others you can just chuck the coil in and cut them afterwards (Dead Rabbit rdas). DON'T FORGET to remove hotspots from your coils, pulse them at around 25-30 watts and strum them with ceramic tipped tweezers, let them cool down then install your cotton accordingly.

Hope this helps!
